name: Camp Pinecliffe for Girls
description_short: An all-girls overnight camp in Harrison, Maine. It offers a full summer session and a four-week session for first-time campers.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

source.title: Dates & Rates | Camp Pinecliffe for Girls

warnings: The 'Important Dates' list shows Friday, June 25, 2027, Friday, July 23, 2027 and Wednesday, August 11, 2027, but none of the dates are labeled. The full session probably runs June 25 - August 11, 2027, but the page does not say so, so the full session dates were left blank.
The four-week session is only for first-time campers and is described as having 'limited availability.'
Tuition does not cover extra fees: canteen, transportation to and from camp, uniforms, optional horseback riding, and Senior Trips. The amounts for these are not given.
